_about: Suggested improvements, keyed by current type. 'next_step' is the smallest change that moves the clause up the scale while keeping the lender's own drafting. 'top_option' reaches 5/5. Institution names in brackets are placeholders for the parties to choose.

next_step.change: Replace the lender's nomination of the arbitrator with an appointment by an online dispute resolution institution under its rules.
next_step.wording: ...shall be referred to arbitration by a sole arbitrator appointed by an online dispute resolution institution in accordance with its Dispute Resolution Rules...

top_option.change: Name the online dispute resolution institution(s) in the contract.
top_option.wording: ...shall be resolved by arbitration, administered electronically by [named ODR institution, e.g. Presolv360], in accordance with its Dispute Resolution Rules. The arbitration shall be before a sole arbitrator appointed under the Rules...

next_step.change: Let an online dispute resolution institution appoint the arbitrator instead of the parties (or a list proposed by the lender).
next_step.wording: ...by a sole arbitrator appointed by an online dispute resolution institution in accordance with its Dispute Resolution Rules...

top_option.change: Name the online dispute resolution institution(s) in the contract.
top_option.wording: ...shall be resolved by arbitration, administered electronically by [named ODR institution, e.g. Presolv360], in accordance with its Dispute Resolution Rules. The arbitration shall be before a sole arbitrator appointed under the Rules...

next_step.change: Specify that the institution is an online dispute resolution institution that appoints the arbitrator under its rules.
next_step.wording: ...administered electronically by an online dispute resolution institution, which shall appoint a sole arbitrator in accordance with its Dispute Resolution Rules...

top_option.change: Name the institution(s) in the contract instead of describing them.
top_option.wording: ...shall be resolved by arbitration, administered electronically by [named ODR institution, e.g. Presolv360], in accordance with its Dispute Resolution Rules...

next_step.change: Name the ODR institution(s) in the contract instead of referring to a list kept by the lender. Naming more than one, with the initiating party choosing, is also rated 5/5.
next_step.wording: ...administered electronically, as chosen by the party initiating the arbitration, by either [named ODR institution, e.g. Presolv360] or [second named ODR institution], in accordance with its Dispute Resolution Rules...

top_option.change: Same as the next step: name the institution(s).
top_option.wording: ...shall be resolved by arbitration, administered electronically by [named ODR institution, e.g. Presolv360], in accordance with its Dispute Resolution Rules...

next_step.change: No change needed to the appointment. Check the other details, for example that a single seat is named.

top_option.change: Already at the top of the scale.
